<script>
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', function(event) {
        let dataAnnouncementIdStr=sessionStorage.getItem('cameFromForward')
        let dataAnnouncementIdArr = [];
        if(dataAnnouncementIdStr){
            // sessionStorage.removeItem('cameFromForward')
            // location.reload();
            dataAnnouncementIdArr = JSON.parse(dataAnnouncementIdStr);
            // 遍历ID数组
            dataAnnouncementIdArr.forEach(function(id) {
                // 获取具有特定ID的元素
                let element = document.getElementById('new-article-category'+id);

                // 检查元素是否存在
                if (element) {
                    // 移除元素的'myClass'类
                    element.classList.remove('is-new');
                }
            });
        }
    });

    // 获取所有带有特定class的元素
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('.article-item');

    // 为每个元素添加点击事件监听器
    elements.forEach(function(element) {
        element.addEventListener('click', function() {
            let dataAnnouncementIdStr = sessionStorage.getItem('cameFromForward');
            let dataAnnouncementIdArr = [];
            if(dataAnnouncementIdStr){
                 dataAnnouncementIdArr = JSON.parse(dataAnnouncementIdStr);
            }
            let dataAnnouncementId = this.getAttribute('data-announcement-id');
            dataAnnouncementIdArr.push(dataAnnouncementId)
            const uniqueDataAnnouncementIdArr = dataAnnouncementIdArr.filter((item, index) => dataAnnouncementIdArr.indexOf(item) === index);
            let newDataAnnouncementIdStr = JSON.stringify(uniqueDataAnnouncementIdArr);
            sessionStorage.setItem('cameFromForward', newDataAnnouncementIdStr);
            // 移除元素的class
            let newElements = this.querySelectorAll('h2');
            // 遍历<p>元素
            newElements.forEach(function(pElement) {
                // 打印或操作<p>元素
                pElement.classList.remove('is-new')
                // 你可以在这里对pElement进行任何操作
            });
        });
    });
</script>
